title: Nim: heap removal with Sprague-Grundy theory
description: 2 players, N heaps of objects. Each turn: choose a heap, remove 1 or more objects from it. Player who takes the last object loses (misère) or wins (normal). Mathematically solved via XOR of heap sizes. Simplest meaningful strategy game. Demonstrates: counter-based zones (heaps), variable action count, mathematically provable optimal play. Perfect information, no randomness, fully client_verifiable.
